summary_en: Open House Group authorized the acquisition of up to 5.0 million shares (4.55% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of ¥25.0 billion through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from November 9, 2026 to September 30, 2027. All acquired shares will be cancelled on October 29, 2027.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
Open House Group's board of directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock on November 6, 2026. The company will purchase up to 5.0 million shares through market transactions on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with a maximum expenditure of ¥25.0 billion. This represents 4.55% of outstanding shares (109,839,823 shares as of the authorization date). The acquisition period runs from November 9, 2026 through September 30, 2027, with an implied per-share ceiling price of ¥5,000 based on the aggregate limit.

The company intends to cancel all acquired shares on October 29, 2027. The cancellation is designed to increase the ratio of shares in circulation and limit future dilution effects. Management identified three objectives for the program: flexible capital allocation, enhancement of shareholder value, and improvement of the free float ratio to sustain future share buybacks.

The buyback is part of the company's shareholder return policy, which targets a combined total return ratio (dividends and share repurchases) of 40% or above. The board emphasized that actual acquisitions may be suspended in whole or part depending on market conditions.
